newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Telrad denies Nortel exercised options.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Telrad denies Nortel exercised options.

text.p: Koor Industries Ltd denied that Northern Telecom Ltd has exercised its option to buy 20 percent of its wholly owned telecommunications subsidiary Telrad.

The Israeli newspaper Haaretz reported the Canadian company exercised its option this week to buy the shares for $45 million. The newspaper also said Northern Telecom received an additional option to increase its stake to 50 percent.
"This is not true," a spokeswoman for Koor and Telrad said. Such a move would have to be reported to the stock exchange, she noted.
The spokeswoman said negotiations with Northern Telecom were continuing but there was nothing new to report.
Northern Telecom has until the end of the year to exercise its option.
Koor, Israel's largest conglomerate, is also listed in New York.
